name: hero-digital-success
blurb: Dark hero with cyan-blue shader backdrop and staggered scroll animations.
description: Full-screen hero (dark) with ShaderGradient WebGL backdrop (cyan to deep blue), responsive nav, large headline with gradient text accent, dual CTAs, and service card grid footer. Uses TimelineAnimation for scroll-triggered stagger.
use_when: Agency/services landing page highlighting full-stack capabilities with modern, tech-forward aesthetic.
avoid_when: WebGL-expensive shader gradient. Requires TimelineAnimation scroll handler and Observer API.
a11y: Navigation and CTAs are focusable. Shader is decorative. No prefers-reduced-motion guard for animations.
